scope: GitHub publication only; leave private source workspace files intact
review_rules: Match paths case-insensitively and reject symbolic links or junctions.
The named prompt exception bypasses only its filename block, never credential or privacy checks.
Scan allowed source and documentation contents, not only filenames.
Reject real passwords, tokens, keys, credential URLs, private hostnames, personal details and local user paths.
Reject AI role instructions, hidden prompt text, conversation exports and private engineering notes even under ordinary filenames.
Product documentation describing configuration or commands is allowed after review; instructions addressed to an AI agent are private.
Test credentials must be demonstrably synthetic and reviewed individually; never exempt an entire test directory.
Do not copy Git history, release databases, encrypted archives or environment files.
A clean automated scan is not proof that arbitrary private information is absent; review each candidate file.
Unknown or ambiguous files stay local until the owner explicitly approves them.
